The solution:

```python
import requests

BASE = "http://api.odyssey.test"

r = requests.get(BASE + "/stats")
print("without key:", r.status_code)

r = requests.get(BASE + "/stats", headers={"X-API-Key": "demo-key-123"})
stats = r.json()
print("with key:", r.status_code)
print("books:", stats["books"])
print("newest:", stats["newest"])
```

hint.tr: Anahtarlı /stats isteği gelmedi: başlık adı X-API-Key, değeri demo-key-123 olmalı.
hint.en: No /stats request with the key arrived: the header name must be X-API-Key and the value demo-key-123.
